contract.frame_stack_order: oldest to newest; last frame of each action repeat

graph_influence.intervention: all edges removed; identical pixels and parameters

initial.execution: one separate evaluation process; episodes sequential; no optimizer
initial.normalization: pixels / 255; no running observation or reward statistics
initial.limitations: Small fixed seed sample; changing seeds does not diversify deterministic NES play.

latest.normalization: pixels / 255; no running observation or reward statistics
latest.limitations: Small fixed seed sample; changing seeds does not diversify deterministic NES play.

watch.execution: one separate evaluation process; episodes sequential; no optimizer
watch.normalization: pixels / 255; no running observation or reward statistics
watch.limitations: Small fixed seed sample; changing seeds does not diversify deterministic NES play.

run_manifest.algorithm: PPO-Clip; GAE; full-rollout batch per epoch; Adam; FP32; no running normalization

assumptions.normalization: none; weight = synapse count as float64
assumptions.randomness: none; ascending numeric IDs and lexicographic edge indices
assumptions.sign: nonnegative structural weights; neurotransmitter does not establish sign
assumptions.threshold: sum all neuropils per directed neuron pair, then filter

connectivity.definition: directed paths from any input to any output

coverage.selection: induced subgraph of selected proofread neurons

model.architecture: conv/pool/linear pixel encoder -> COO propagation -> output-only actor/critic
model.mapping: learned engineering mapping to input nodes; output nodes flattened for readout
model.sign_assumption: structural positive weights; not neurotransmitter sign inference
model.state: zero per observation, repeated input drive, tanh propagation; no temporal recurrence

run_manifest.worker_model: one in-process environment; one bounded ffmpeg encoder, reaped on close

evaluation_protocol.preprocessing: Pillow bilinear; oldest-to-newest frame stack; pixels / 255
evaluation_protocol.normalization: no running observation or reward statistics
evaluation_protocol.action_selection: torch.multinomial on CPU probabilities; local CPU Generator seeded per episode
evaluation_protocol.comparison_rule: same protocol only; report distributions, not a learning-success claim
evaluation_protocol.limitations: Small fixed seed sample; changing seeds does not diversify deterministic NES play.
